dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Guero arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. His previous owner describes him as active and playful. In his previous home, Guero was reported to bark and growl towards strangers and other dogs. He is also noted to resource guard in his previous home. While in care, Guero has been observed to be fearful. Noted to retreat from handlers quickly when they attempted to collar him. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Guero
